errors.evidence: The x-axis ticks are labeled 1, 4, 7, 10, 13, 16, 19. The step interval is 3, not 1.

errors.text_span: 其中在1处的刻度值标记为“感概”，在16处的刻度值标记为“厌恶”
errors.evidence: The labels “感概” and “厌恶” are annotations on the plot near the curve, not labels for the tick marks at x=1 and x=16.
The y-axis has no numerical labels. The range from -10 to 10 is fabricated.

errors.text_span: 以标有“感概”和“厌恶”的标记表示
errors.evidence: The y-axis is not represented by the markers “感概” and “厌恶”. These are annotations for different emotional phases along the curve. The y-axis label is “情绪”.

errors.text_span: 到约7处的最高点达到最大值
errors.evidence: The curve reaches its maximum value (peak) visibly between x=7 and x=10, likely around x=8 or x=9, not at x=7.

errors.text_span: 随后向右下降到约13处的最低值
errors.evidence: The curve does not reach its minimum value at x=13; it crosses the x-axis (y=0) at approximately x=13. The lowest point on the graph is at the far right, around x=19.

errors.text_span: 最后又回到约16处的近似原点
errors.evidence: The curve does not return to the origin (0,0) at x=16. At x=16, the curve is clearly in the negative y-range.
The description omits the annotation “喜爱” which is clearly visible at the peak of the curve.
